thesis_text: Spider silk for bullet proof vests

case.name: Proxy evidence remains bounded
case.description: Proxy, indirect, or anecdotal evidence must not be treated as direct application proof.
case.expected_behavior: Non-application evidence is bounded and the proxy-to-application leap is preserved.

results.message: Proxy evidence is bounded before application-level claims.

case.name: A6 requires direct prospective validation
case.description: Prospective validation should remain unsupported without independent direct evidence.
case.expected_behavior: A6 support is unsupported with low confidence when no direct validation exists.

results.message: A6 remains appropriately low without direct validation.

case.name: Limiting evidence is preserved
case.description: Contradictory or limiting sources must stay visible in the belief update.
case.expected_behavior: Limiting evidence remains contradictory and contributes to invalid-leap handling.

results.message: Limiting evidence remains contradictory and bounded.

case.name: Conflict/failure links are present
case.description: The eval workshop must link conflicts, invalid leaps, verifier failures, and evals.
case.expected_behavior: Workshop links include invalid-leap, conflict, and verifier failure edges.

results.message: Conflict and failure links are present in the eval workshop.

case.name: Replay does not increase overcredited confidence
case.description: Replay after applying the generated eval should lower or preserve confidence.
case.expected_behavior: Replay outcomes pass and confidence does not increase after eval application.

results.message: Replay lowers or preserves confidence after eval application.

generated_eval_fixtures.failure_observed: The system risked accepting this inference: Mixed weak/conflicting sources -> stable discovery belief.

generated_eval_fixtures.eval_rule: Classify the evidence by what it directly measures, not by the stronger thesis it suggests.
generated_eval_fixtures.expected_behavior: The agent should downgrade support, preserve the limitation, and ask for decisive follow-up evidence.
